name: Lisinopril
description: An ACE inhibitor used to treat high blood pressure, heart failure, and to improve survival after heart attack.

name: Metformin
description: A biguanide used as a first-line treatment for type 2 diabetes to help control blood sugar levels.

name: Atorvastatin
description: A statin medication used to lower cholesterol levels and reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease.

name: Amoxicillin
description: A penicillin-type antibiotic used to treat many different bacterial infections.

name: Omeprazole
description: A proton pump inhibitor used to reduce stomach acid and treat GERD, ulcers, and other acid-related conditions.

name: Amlodipine
description: A calcium channel blocker used to treat high blood pressure and coronary artery disease.

name: Sertraline
description: An SSRI antidepressant used to treat depression, panic attacks, PTSD, OCD, and social anxiety disorder.

name: Montelukast
description: A leukotriene receptor antagonist used for prevention and chronic treatment of asthma and allergic rhinitis.
